Shield of Ahimsa: Gain a shield every other turn and take 35% less damage.
Shiny Steal: Steal 10% of enemy’s HP and ATK after damaging.

Sky Drop: Attacks every other turn, dodges attacks on turns it doesn't. 1.5x Damage.

Sorrow: inherits 50% of Max HP and 60% of Damage of The Broken One

Telekinesis: Deal 2x damage, then 4x with a meteor.

Transcend Time: Dodge every other attack, starting with first.

Twilight Sparkle: 40% chance every turn to heal to full.
Tyrannospirit: On entry, for every Fossil, 1.5x damage.

Unforgiving: Reduce enemy's Max HP by damage dealt.

Unpaid 'Interns': This card must be defeated 3 times before it can die.
Untouchable: Enemy’s hit chance is squared ratio of damage to your Max HP.
Upheaval: Every 3 turns, opponent rests, and you gain 100% damage.
Vainglory: +50% damage, -30% damage taken. Fades below half HP.

Viral Breath: The opponent loses 25% of its HP each turn.
Void Heart: Each turn gain 1 Void stack. At 3 Void, consume them to make the next attack deal 100% increased Damage and heal 25% Max HP.
Voracity: Heal and gain damage by 20% after a kill.
Wail: Stun attacker when HP drops below half.
War Scythe: On entry, attack the first 2 enemies, bypassing defensive and on-death abilities.

We Want YOU: Buff next card's damage by 400%, but it dies after attacking.
Whooping: Deals 100% more damage to younger cards.

World Creation: Double HP and ATK every 3 turns.
